title: STL Algorithms, Maps, and a Progress Tracker
summary: Combine vector, map, set, algorithms, lambdas, file streams, exceptions, and RAII in a tested progress-tracker project.

Compile and test behavior with observable evidence

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: The standard library provides containers, iterators, algorithms, and resource-managing types. `std::map` associates ordered unique keys with values; `std::unordered_map` provides hash-based lookup without sorted iteration. Algorithms such as `std::find_if`, `std::count_if`, and `std::accumulate` separate traversal from intent. Lambdas provide local callable behavior and should capture only what they need. File streams close automatically through RAII, but open, read, and write state must still be checked. Parse persisted data as untrusted input before constructing valid domain objects.
keyPoints: The standard library provides containers, iterators, algorithms, and resource-managing types.
commonMistakes: unnecessary shared mutation complicates lifetime reasoning
